# OMP Session Gateway

> Native integration with stock Oh My Pi (OMP) >=18.1.20. No OMP fork, custom build, gateway-specific OMP plugin or publisher credential. v0.7.6 is qualified for stable promotion; publication is pending. The separate gateway discovers collaboration-enabled sessions and opens OMP's encrypted View/Control client. Setup requires collab.autoStart, Bun 1.4.0, gateway installation and TUN-mode Tailscale Serve with Funnel disabled. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by OMP.
<!-- release-generate:summary:end -->

## Supported platforms

- Supported and tested in CI on every change (the stock-OMP canaries run daily): Linux, macOS, and Windows gateway hosts; Chrome and Chromium, Edge through Chromium, Firefox, Safari/WebKit, and Android; iPhone and iPad as a WebKit browser, emulated in CI. Supported is not qualified: qualification is the exact hardware matrix below. Lanes: portable-source (Ubuntu, macOS, Windows), browser-core (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, iPhone-class WebKit), browser-notifications (Pixel sizes), windows-service-lifecycle, canary and canary-windows.

## Current qualification boundary

<!-- release-generate:boundary:start -->
v0.7.6 is qualified for stable promotion; publication is pending. [Release v0.7.6](https://github.com/carrythroughsystems/omp-session-gateway/releases/tag/v0.7.6). Signed candidate v0.7.6-prealpha.2; source 28fbdf57b1eab8437f2bba0cd1f753960cc3925f; archive SHA-256 96a78778608b1b232fd586abc012199c2cd10d6edb7b38a60f241d09720a89cd. Published v0.7.5 remains the predecessor. Stock OMP v18.8.9 (fa5ff4a3a977a28b93d025f4cf50f046e019f18c), Bun 1.4.0. All thirteen lanes passed; attempt counts and measured evidence are in the [release ledger](RELEASE_STATUS.md). Stable publication and published-byte smoke are pending.

- artifacts (1 attempt): Signed tag, checksums, GitHub attestations 3/3 and Sigstore bundles 3/3; v0.7.5 verified by digest-pinned historical Cosign bundles 3/3 (no GitHub build attestations).
- debian (1 attempt): Run 38093821367 succeeded (https://github.com/carrythroughsystems/omp-session-gateway/actions/runs/38093821367); OS/kernel versions and migration counts are not exported.
- macos (1 attempt): VirtualMac2,1, macOS 27.0 arm64; doctor 18/18, rollback 23/23; native addon 76a98a98c7adbe5481e1ac3ede2b7c6c889443dc5edd10929854e1ebde10c1b7.
- ompPublication (1 attempt): Stock OMP v18.8.9; generation 1; publication, View/Control, new-generation/fork/resume and revocation.
- android (1 attempt): Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17 build CP3A.261005.005, Chrome 154.0.8037.126; same-page unlock 6991 ms, Airplane 6906 ms, Doze 123 ms; 7/7 detectable; clean.
- androidPush (1 attempt): Android 17, Chrome 154.0.8037.126, installed WebAPK; force-stop delivered_while_force_stopped, Doze delivered_after_doze_exit; outcomes are observed variants, not delivery guarantees.
- androidPushCleanup (1 attempt): Device, browser and fixture restored.
- deviceCloud (1 attempt): TestingBot real devices, tunnel 4.9: iPhone 17 Pro Max (26.6, safari 26.6); iPad (9th generation) (26.6, safari 26.6); Galaxy S26 (16.0.0, chrome 145.0.7632.159). Home Screen alerts do not qualify lock-screen presentation.
- deviceCloudCleanup (1 attempt): Restored.
- relay (1 attempt): 1800 seconds, 2026-10-10T23:18:36.965Z–2026-10-10T23:48:36.978Z; 2 transitions, final phase live. Eight-hour endurance is not claimed.
- cleanup (1 attempt): Zero gateway processes, listeners and live OMP hosts.
- windows (1 attempt): Windows x86-64 build 26100; 4 CPUs, 8186 MiB; Administrator upgrade/rollback from v0.7.5 and fresh standard-account lifecycle; interactive logon, not unattended boot.
- windowsCleanup (1 attempt): Zero instances and firewalls; tailnet node deleted and access vault removed.

The Mac guest does not qualify physical firmware, FileVault, Secure Boot or startup before login. Cloud devices qualify the browser, not phone-owned Tailscale identity; iPhone Home Screen alerts do not qualify lock-screen presentation. Gateway rollback does not switch OMP. Other hosts and browser builds remain outside this exact matrix. Portal Tunnel and self-hosted/proxied relays are unsupported.

## Fork-era release history

- v0.3.0 requires its exact patched OMP v18.1.14 and matching historical instructions. Its qualification does not transfer to the mainline architecture.
